description: This file contains C source code for parsing JSON configurations related to gateway and feedback tables in an OVS (Open vSwitch) agent, including functions for parsing table data, memory management, and extracting JSON string values.

classes.name: Gateway_Config
classes.description: Structure holding configuration details for a network gateway, including interface name, type, address, netmask, GRE tunneling addresses, parent interface info, MTU, VLAN ID, and parent bridge.

classes.name: Feedback
classes.description: Structure for feedback information, primarily holding a request UUID and status.

methods.name: OVS_STATUS parse_table(const char * table_name,json_t * update,Rdkb_Table_Config * table_config)
methods.description: Main function to parse a JSON update for a specified table name, dispatching to specific parsers based on table type.

methods.name: OVS_STATUS gateway_config_parser(json_t * json,Rdkb_Table_Config * table_config)
methods.description: Parses JSON data into a Gateway_Config structure, allocating memory and copying string and integer fields.

methods.name: OVS_STATUS feedback_config_parser(json_t * json,Rdkb_Table_Config * table_config)
methods.description: Parses JSON data into a Feedback structure, allocating memory and copying string and integer fields.

methods.name: const char * json_fetch_string(json_t * root,const char * key)
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from a JSON object by key, with error handling.

ctags.name: json_fetch_string
ctags.pattern: /^static const char * json_fetch_string(json_t * root, const char *key)$/

ctags.name: parse_table
ctags.pattern: /^OVS_STATUS parse_table(const char * table_name, json_t* update, Rdkb_Table_Config* table_config)$/
